newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to begin trading options on new energy index.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to begin trading options on new energy index.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Wednesday it will begin trading options on the NatWest Energy Index on June 10.

The index, made up of 30 companies in the international and domestic oil, natural gas exploration and production, oil serivces, equipment manufacturing, drilling and refining, is equal dollar weighted.
Companies in the index include Atlantic Richfield Co, Unocal Corp, Exxon Corp, Apache Corp, Oryx Energy Co, Halliburton Co, Global Marine Inc and Tosco Corp.
The AMEX said the NEX options will be European-style, meaning they can only be exercised on the expiration date.
It said strike prices will be set closer to the start of trading. The options will trade on the March cycle, but exact initial expiration months have yet to be set.
The index fell 1.43 points, or about 0.50 percent, to 271.92 Wednesday.
